item.title: Digitalisation News Brief — 2026-11-18
item.description:
1. [Tech News] India’s Humyn Labs raises $47M to feed U.S. robotics companies the data they need
Founded in February, Humyn Labs competes with startups including Mecka AI and XDOF, with about 90% of its revenue coming from the U.S.

2. [Tech News] Hydropower hit record lows in the US Southwest this summer
The US Southwest generated 28% less electricity via hydropower between April and August than the 10-year average, according to new data from the US Energy Information Administration. Most hydropower plants in the US rely on dams to hold back water, creating reservoirs. The water

3. [Tech News] Nvidia promises that revenue will keep soaring — for now
Despite the turmoil Nvidia is in after the departure of its disgraced founder and CEO Jensen Huang, the company projected that its streak of record-breaking revenue isn't about to stop.

4. [Tech News] Amazon and Google will together own nearly 30% of Anthropic after its IPO
Amazon will own just under 15% of Anthropic after the IPO, with the option to go much higher. Google is a close second with holdings of nearly 14%.

5. [Tech News] Model ML raises $250M to automate investment banking grunt work
The startup says its agents understand the full context of deals that bankers and consultants are working on and can automatically update financial models and presentations when new developments affect their analysis.
